content.text: In your own words, explain how you would choose A and C without choosing B, then submit your answer.

question.explanation: This original interface fixture demonstrates writing an answer and rating it yourself. It is not an IT knowledge assessment.

content.text: Select A and C, leave B unselected, then press Submit.

rubric.criterion: Describes choosing both A and C.

anchors.0: Does not describe selecting A or C.
anchors.1: Describes selecting only one of A and C.
anchors.2: Clearly describes selecting both A and C.

rubric.criterion: Describes leaving B unselected before submitting.

anchors.0: Does not describe excluding B or submitting.
anchors.1: Describes excluding B or submitting, but not both.
anchors.2: Clearly describes excluding B and then submitting.
